verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de publishes a per-endpoint API reference covering incorporation, notarization, translation, tax registration and trade registration. It also offers webhook guides and an llms.txt index. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that examples can be run in-browser, and no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, a public OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and hands-on corroboration.
